task.title: Count sales by customer
task.statement: Using GROUP BY and COUNT, return customer_id and sale_count for each customer.
expected_evidence: Group sale rows at customer granularity and count rows.

hidden_variables.name: repeated_customer
hidden_variables.purpose: Require counting multiple sales per customer.

private.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS sale_count FROM sales GROUP BY customer_id
hints: Think about which entity should occupy one output row.
The grouping key identifies the customer; count the sale rows inside each group.
Start with SELECT customer_id and COUNT(*) before grouping.
private.solution_explanation: GROUP BY creates one group per customer; COUNT counts the sale rows in each group.
